purpose: Remove all remote protocol reads between REGISTER and GET_NEXT while preserving branch isolation and non-blocking telemetry.
invariants: After REGISTER, worker immediately attempts REGISTERED checkpoint and then GET_NEXT in the same turn.
No START_HERE fetch is required or allowed.
Workers never write main or gh-pages.
Each worker writes only its own branch.
Telemetry failure never stops material work.
Allocator claim and RETURN durability are the only coordination/durability blockers.
